info.title: EPFD API
info.summary: Easy Peasy Flyer Distribution — REST API v1
info.description: REST API for **Easy Peasy Flyer Distribution** — letterbox distribution campaigns, print orders, payments, support and back-office operations. Base URL: `/api/v1`. All bodies are JSON (`Accept: application/json`) except artwork upload (`multipart/form-data`). ## Authentication * **Bearer token** — `POST /auth/login` with `email`, `password`, `device_name` returns `{token, user}`. Send `Authorization: Bearer `. `POST /auth/logout` revokes the current token. * **Session cookie** — the EPFD web app calls the same endpoints with its first-party session cookie (Laravel Sanctum stateful SPA auth; send `X-XSRF-TOKEN` on writes). * Admin endpoints (`/admin/*`) require a staff role (super_admin, operations, finance, support) **and** the permission shown as `x-permission` on each operation. Distributor endpoints require `is_distributor`. * Demo accounts (password `password`): `demo@business.test` (approved business), `admin@epfd.test`, `ops@epfd.test`, `finance@epfd.test`, `support@epfd.test`. ## Rate limits | Limiter | Limit | Applies to | |---|---|---| | `api` | 120 requests / minute per user (or IP) | every endpoint | | `estimate` | 240 / minute | `POST /areas/estimate`, `PUT /campaigns/{id}/areas`, `POST /business/areas` | | `auth` | 10 / minute per IP | register, login, password reset, OTP | | `payments` | 10 / minute | `POST …/pay` | Exceeding a limit returns **429** `rate_limited` with a `Retry-After` header. ## Pagination List endpoints accept `?page=` and `?per_page=` (default 20, **max 100**) and return Laravel's paginator envelope: `data`, `links {first,last,prev,next}` and `meta {current_page, from, last_page, per_page, to, total}`. ## Idempotency `POST /campaigns/{id}/pay` and `POST /print/orders/{id}/pay` accept an `Idempotency-Key` header. Retrying with the same key returns the original payment instead of charging twice. Webhooks are de-duplicated by event id. ## Money All amounts are integer **cents in AUD**. Prices are shown ex GST with a separate GST (10%) line; `total_cents` is GST-inclusive. ## Coordinates & CRS Geometries are GeoJSON with **[longitude, latitude]** order. Data is stored and queried in **GDA2020 (EPSG:7844)**. WGS84 lon/lat from browsers/GPS is accepted as GDA2020 — the ~1.8 m datum offset is negligible for letterbox counting. Distances and areas are computed in the matching **MGA2020 zone (EPSG:7849–7856)**. Letterbox counts are always computed server-side; client counts are never trusted. ## Errors Errors use **RFC 9457** `application/problem+json`: ```json {"type": "/docs#errors-validation_failed", "title": "Validation failed", "status": 422, "detail": "The name field is required.", "instance": "/api/v1/campaigns", "code": "validation_failed", "errors": {"name": ["The name field is required."]}} ``` `code` is stable and machine-readable: | Code | HTTP | Meaning | |---|---|---| | `validation_failed` | 422 | The request body failed validation. See `errors`. | | `unauthenticated` | 401 | Missing or invalid Bearer token / session. | | `forbidden` | 403 | Authenticated but not allowed (role, ownership or business status). | | `not_found` | 404 | Resource does not exist or is not visible to you. | | `rate_limited` | 429 | Too many requests. Retry after the `Retry-After` header. | | `conflict` | 409 | State conflict, e.g. paying an already-paid campaign. | | `business_not_approved` | 403 | The business is pending approval or suspended; payment is blocked. | | `polygon_invalid_geojson` | 422 | Area is not a GeoJSON Polygon of [lon, lat] pairs. | | `polygon_too_few_vertices` | 422 | Fewer than 3 distinct vertices. | | `polygon_too_many_vertices` | 422 | More than the maximum vertices (500). | | `polygon_self_intersection` | 422 | Edges cross each other. | | `polygon_invalid` | 422 | Geometry invalid for another reason (see `reason`). | | `polygon_has_holes` | 422 | Polygons with interior rings are not accepted. | | `polygon_outside_australia` | 422 | A vertex lies outside Australia. | | `polygon_too_small` | 422 | Area below the minimum size. | | `polygon_too_large` | 422 | Area above the maximum size (60 km²). | | `area_outside_pickup_radius` | 422 | Area is not even partly within 20 km of the pickup point. | | `no_letterboxes` | 422 | The area contains no letterboxes; fees are unavailable. | | `pricing_unavailable_combination` | 422 | Print product option combination is not offered. | | `promo_invalid` | 422 | Promo code unknown, expired or not applicable. | | `payment_declined` | 402 | The card was declined by the payment gateway. | | `price_changed` | 409 | The order total changed since it was shown (e.g. a promo expired or prices were updated). Re-read the order and pay again. | | `payment_in_progress` | 409 | A payment for this order is still being authorised by the bank; retry shortly. | | `payment_action_required` | 402 | The card needs customer authentication (3-D Secure). Complete it with `client_secret` in the browser SDK, then POST `confirm_url`. | | `letterbox_source_unavailable` | 503 | The configured letterbox data source is unavailable. | | `invalid_state` | 409 | The resource is not in a state that allows this action (e.g. run status transition). | | `pricing_unknown_addon` | 422 | Unknown print or design add-on code. | | `pricing_unknown_design_type` | 422 | Unknown design service. Valid keys are listed by GET /design/services (admin-managed). | | `pricing_unknown_package` | 422 | Unknown design package, or the service has no price for it. See GET /design/services. | | `webhook_signature_invalid` | 400 | Webhook signature missing or invalid. | | `mail_unavailable` | 503 | The email could not be sent right now; retry shortly. | | `refund_failed` | 502 | The payment gateway rejected the refund. | | `server_error` | 500 | Unexpected error. The `instance` id is logged. | ## Test payments (mock gateway) Card `4242 4242 4242 4242` succeeds; `4000 0000 0000 0002` is declined (**402** `payment_declined`). Any future expiry / CVC. ## Address data licence Incorporates or developed using G-NAF © Geoscape Australia licensed by the Commonwealth of Australia under the Open Geo-coded National Address File (G-NAF) End User Licence Agreement. Letterbox counts are estimates derived from G-NAF address points and may differ from what is physically present. Licence: https://data.gov.au/data/dataset/geocoded-national-address-file-g-naf

post.description:
No auth: the signature is verified by the gateway (`X-EPFD-Signature` = hex HMAC-SHA256 of the raw
body with the mock secret; Stripe uses `Stripe-Signature`). Idempotent: a repeated event id returns
`{"status":"duplicate"}`. Handles `payment.succeeded`, `payment.failed`, `payment.refunded`,
`payment_intent.succeeded` and `charge.refunded`; other types are acknowledged and ignored.

PayRequest.description:
Checkout body shared by campaign, print and design payment. Provide a `payment_method` id from the
gateway's SDK (Stripe: `pm_…`), a `saved_card_id`, or — with the mock gateway only — a raw test `card`.
Omit them all when credits cover the total. A 402 `payment_action_required` response means the card needs
3-D Secure: complete it with `client_secret`, then POST `confirm_url`.

expected_total_cents.description: The total the customer was shown (cents). When it no longer matches, nothing is charged (409 `price_changed`).
